description: 행정안전부_지진가속도계측기 설치 현황 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 행정안전부의 ‘지진가속도계측기 설치 현황’ 데이터는 「지진·지진해일 및 화산재해 대책법」 제14조에 근거하여 구축된 지진관측체계의 일환으로, 전국 주요 시설물 및 지역에 설치된 지진가속도계측기의. The portal shows 2025-08-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
